findings.body: In packages/app-store/vital/lib/reschedule.ts and packages/app-store/wipemycalother/lib/reschedule.ts, the code uses forEach with an async callback to perform asynchronous operations (lines 125-134). This pattern does not wait for the async operations to complete, leading to potential unhandled promise rejections and race conditions. The correct approach is to use a for...of loop with await or collect promises and await Promise.all to ensure all async operations complete before proceeding.
findings.title: Async forEach callback does not await promises

findings.body: Similar async forEach misuse is present in packages/app-store/wipemycalother/lib/reschedule.ts at lines 125-134, causing the same issue as above.

models.summary: The change introduces multiple instances where async functions are called inside Array.forEach without awaiting their completion. This leads to potential unhandled promise rejections and race conditions. These should be replaced with for...of loops or Promise.all to properly await asynchronous operations. Other changes correctly handle async/await usage when importing modules dynamically.
